column1: # Edges. Cycles here are informative, not errors: SCCs are usually subsystems.
# PROVENANCE: Ghidra contributed none of these. `ghidra graph calls` returned
# edge_count=0 over node_count=18299 because Ghidra decoded 0 instructions
# for this managed binary (dec013). The edges are derived instead from the
# decompiled C# declarations: base/interface -> inherits, a type named in a
# method signature -> uses. Ambiguous short names are skipped, not guessed.
# dropped_reason: the same (from,to,kind) triple seen more than once folds to one edge
